newsitem.title: TURKEY: Bomb blast kills six, hurts 50 in southeast Turkey.
newsitem.headline: Bomb blast kills six, hurts 50 in southeast Turkey.

text.p: A powerful bomb blast at a wedding party killed at least six civilians and wounded 50, many of them woman and children, in southeast Turkey, officials said on Saturday.
They said a group of attackers, whom they had not identified yet, might have thrown the bomb at the dancing crowd in a district of the Cizre town, near the Iraqi border, on Friday night.
Witnesses said village guards, members of a government-paid militia against the rebel Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK), shot in the air to seek help from security forces after the explosion.
One security official at the diyarbakir hospital said: "So far there are six people killed and 50 people wounded."

"The explosion occurred while some people were dancing and others watching them. The PKK might have done it because we are village guards," Idris Idim, a wounded guard taken to a hospital in Diyarbakir, told Reuters.

Idim said the wedding belonged to the Kulanc family, many of whose men became village guards during the 12-year-old fight against the PKK's war for independence or autonomy in southeast Turkey in which more than 26,000 people have died.
